verdict_reason: Endpoints behave as the README and tests describe, but the stub-only empty-answer branches log nothing and the APIM header name and empty search-page shape each have more than one home.

todos.issue: The stub's own fallbacks answer silently: an unsaved search term gets an empty page (line 76-77), an unknown species code or a page past the saved ones gets an empty page (line 97-101), and unknown codes on /commodities are dropped (line 53). None of these exist in real MDM, and nothing logs them, so someone debugging the docker-compose stack cannot tell 'MDM found nothing' from 'the stub has no saved answer for this term or code'.
todos.fix: Must: each branch where the stub answers from no saved fixture logs once at the point of decision, with the term or code and the endpoint, so a developer can see the stub had nothing saved. One way: log.info("No saved MDM product search for q '{}'; answering an empty page", query) in the saved == null branch, and the same for an unknown species code and for each commodity code left out.

todos.issue: OCP_APIM_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY = "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key" is now declared a third time (CountriesController:20, PortsOfEntryController:18, ProductController:26) in the same PR that extracts MdmStubResponses as the shared home for MDM-through-APIM response details. The APIM header name is one MDM-wide value with three owners.
todos.fix: Must: the APIM subscription-key header name is declared once for the mdm stubs and every MDM controller uses that one constant. One way: move it to a public constant on MdmStubResponses (or a sibling MdmApim holder in the mdm package) and reference it from all three controllers' @RequestHeader.

todos.issue: The shape of an empty search page is assembled in two places: line 77 'emptyPage(page, size, 0).put("totalPages", 0)' and line 81-82 'emptyPage(page, size, total).put("totalPages", ...)'. emptyPage builds the species-page shape (no totalPages), and each search branch bolts totalPages on by hand, so the rule 'a search page carries totalPages' has two homes.
todos.fix: Must: one function owns the empty search-page shape (including totalPages), and both search branches call it. One way: add emptySearchPage(page, size, totalElements, totalPages) that calls emptyPage and puts totalPages, and use it at lines 77 and 81.

todos.issue: MINIMUM_QUERY_LENGTH (line 31) is used only by search() (lines 67-70) but sits at class scope. House rule: a literal used by one function lives in that function; module scope is for shared values and module set-up (the fixture paths at lines 27-30 are set-up and may stay).
todos.fix: Must: the minimum query length lives in search(), the one method that uses it. One way: declare it as a local final int at the top of search().
